description: The right-click menu on a tab of the main area's tab bar. Record only (Baude's tabs have no menu).
opens: Right-click a tab in Record's main tab bar

actions.does: Puts that tab's absolute link on the clipboard (a file path with :line, a notes page's file, a chat's transcript) and toasts "Link copied", or "This page has no link to copy".

parts.name: Rename…
parts.shows: "Rename…" (the common wording); greyed on every tab that isn't a chat.

actions.does: Asks for a new name for that chat (the window's rename dialog).
